scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic for all stated real parameters. Exact rational tests and numerical cusp checks supplement but do not replace it. Novelty is assessed against identified accessible work, not certified priority.
scientific_limitations: Only a>-1 and c nonzero; no claim about the forward asymptotic dynamics, attractor existence or global bifurcation structure. The Whitney normal form is classical, but the family-specific exact global inverse classification and cusp coefficients are the result. The journal has divergent manuscript-online dates; December 5, 2021 is attested by its publisher listing and article header.
title: Two exact cusps and a sharp three-preimage region in a planar rational map
